title: chant.audit/v1
description: One line of audit.jsonl in a CI product's report store: an event on the gate ledger, or one a product records from its own records. A product's own line (terragucci.audit/v1, sql-yodeler's audit.jsonl) maps onto it with readAuditLine in @intentius/chant/report-store. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

id.description: Over where the line came from; the same records give the same id.

kind.description: The event, from the vocabulary's PRODUCT_AUDIT_KINDS.

product_kind.description: The product's own word for the kind, when it is not kind: approval, apply, migration, silenced, ...

environment.description: The environment, when the product records one per line.

who.description: The approver, the overrider, whoever removed the line, or whoever ran it. Null when nobody did.

what.description: The gate, the root, or the migration.

digest.description: The plan digest it binds. Null when it has none.

result.description: How it came out: waiting, applied, failed, denied, the seal of an approval, ...

table.description: History: the table the row is in.

detail.description: What else the source says, by kind.

product_fields.description: Fields of a product's line that this schema does not name.
